supporting_evidence: Existing single-owner and single-location item invariant

assumptions: Death transfers only top-level owned items into the corpse root

Corpse-owned descendants have null owner until the root container is looted
Looting a root container assigns the looter as owner of every contained descendant

safe_fallback: Circular or invalid container graphs fail validation and recursive cleanup aborts atomically rather than orphaning or silently discarding reachable state.
